chapter.heading: Out of the DepthsA song of ascents.
chapter.v:
Out of
the depthsI cry to You, O LORD!

O Lord,
hear my voice;let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

If You,
O LORD, kept track of iniquities,then who, O Lord, could stand?

But with
You there is forgiveness,so that You may be feared.

I wait
for the LORD; my soul does wait,and in His word I put my hope.

My soul
waits for the Lordmore than watchmen wait for the morning—more than watchmen wait for the morning.

O Israel,
put your hope in the LORD,for with the LORD is loving devotion,and with Him is redemption in abundance.

And He
will redeem Israelfrom all iniquity.
